author: Jamie Theodosi
title: Joe Rogan labeled Justin Gaethje 'the most violent' fighter in the UFC just days before career best win - NewsBreak
text:
By Jamie Theodosi ,
5 hours ago
Justin Gaethje and his team celebrate UFC 249 win. Credit: Douglas P. DeFelice/Getty Images Just days out from one of Justin Gaethje’s biggest fights of his career, he received the highest praise from UFC icon, Joe Rogan.
On January 24, Justin Gaethje will compete for the interim lightweight title for a second time when he takes on Paddy Pimblett in the UFC 324 main event.
The 37-year-old has been a popular fixture in the 155lb division since 2017 when he debuted in the promotion against Michael Johnson .
And ever since then, ‘The Highlight’ has lived up to his nickname, and has put on several incredible shows in the Octagon. But not many were as impressive as his performance over Tony Ferguson back in 2020.
What is your favorite moment from Justin Gaethje’s UFC career so far? 'The Highlight' will look to add another memorable win to his record against Paddy Pimblett at UFC 324.
Left: Justin Gaethje celebrates his win over Michael Johnson in 2017. Right: Justin gaethje in the cage for his fight against Rafael Fiziev in 2025. Credit: Brandon Magnus/Chris Unger/Zuffa LLC via Getty Images 👇 Join the debate; share your insight. Use the comment button on the bottom left to have your say Comment Like or Comment
Joe Rogan labeled Gaethje ‘the most violent fighter’ in the UFC Back in 2020 when Khabib Nurmagomedov reigned over the lightweight division, the COVID-19 pandemic hit which left the Russian unable to defend his title against Ferguson.
And because of that, the promotion booked an interim title fight between ‘El Cucuy’ and Gaethje on short notice for UFC 249.
Just a few days before the event, UFC icon Joe Rogan was asked for his thoughts on the fight, and during a passionate rant, he labeled ‘The Highlight’ the ‘most violent fighter in the sport’.
“Justin Gaethje is a monster, Justin Gaethje is a monster! He’s a monster,” Rogan said during an episode of his Podcast.
“He’s a terrifying individual, in a sport that’s violent, it’s an inherently violent sport, he stands out as the most violent. Do you know how crazy that is?
“Have you ever watched his knockout of Edson Barboza? You watch how that motherf—– attacks people, there’s a reckless abandonment to his calculated wildness, which is terrifying.”
Not long after, Gaethje stepped into the cage in Florida and put on one of his career best performances, utterly battering Ferguson over five rounds.
In some ways, Gaethje is credited for being the one who put an end to Ferguson’s MMA career as his loss to ‘The Highlight’ was the beginning of an eight fight losing streak, which ended with his release from the UFC.
Photo by Jeff Bottari/Zuffa LLC Justin Gaethje has earned a whopping amount of money from bonuses Not only does being labeled as ‘the most violent fighter in the sport’ come with big privilege, but it also comes with a lot of money.
In 14 UFC fights, ‘The Highlight’ has earned 14 bonuses, taking his total to $950,000, one of the most in UFC history for post-fight bonuses.
